info.name: CaseSim API
info.description:
All endpoints of the CaseSim backend. Run the whole collection top to bottom (Runner), or run requests one by one after '1. Auth'.

Setup: import postman/CaseSim.postman_environment.json, select it and fill adminPassword with ADMIN_PASSWORD from your .env.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Health check, sign-up, login. Run these first: they fill the collection variables playerToken and adminToken that every other request uses.

request.description: Is the backend alive and can it reach the database?
Creates a new player with a random nick and stores the returned token in {{playerToken}}.

exec: pm.test("Returns token and user with the starting balance", () => {

request.description: Uses ADMIN_NICK / ADMIN_PASSWORD from your .env file (set adminPassword in the Postman environment).

item.name: 2. Skins (CRUD)
item.description: The main REST resource of the project: list, get by id, create, update, delete. Reading needs any logged-in user, writing needs an admin.

request.description: LIST. Returns { total, limit, offset, items }. Supports ?rarity=, ?q=, ?limit=, ?offset=.

item.name: List skins: filter by rarity and name

exec: pm.test("Every item has the requested rarity", () => json.items.forEach(s => pm.expect(s.rarity).to.eql("rarity_rare_weapon")));

request.description: GET BY ID. Returns one skin with its rarity.
CREATE. The server generates the id. Answers 201 and a Location header.

exec: pm.test("Location header points to the new skin", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.eql("/api/skins/" + json.id));
pm.test("Saved values are returned", () => { pm.expect(json.name).to.eql("Postman | Test Skin"); pm.expect(json.rarity).to.eql("rarity_rare_weapon"); });
pm.test("It is the skin we created", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql("Postman | Test Skin"));

request.description: UPDATE. PUT replaces all editable fields, so send the whole skin.
The pre-request script gives this skin to the player first. A skin that is in somebody's inventory can't be deleted: the database foreign key refuses and the API answers 409.

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ nick: pm.variables.get('playerNick'), skinId: pm.variables.get('lowSkinId') }) }

request.description: DELETE. Answers 204 No Content with an empty body.

item.name: 3. Cases and inventory
item.description: The game itself: look at cases, open one, check the inventory, sell the item.

exec: pm.test("Contains skins with drop chances", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.skins).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(j.skins[0].chance).to.be.a("number"); });
pm.test("Contains the item we just opened", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(i => String(i.id))).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("openedItemId"))));
pm.test("Has both rankings", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.cleanest).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.richest).to.be.an("array"); });

item.name: 5. Trade-up contracts
item.description: 10 items of one rarity become 1 item of the next rarity. The first request prepares 10 items automatically.

request.description: Shows the possible results without spending anything.
